\begin{equation}\label{diffeq}\nabla_X\widetilde Y=-\Ric(\widetilde Y,\cdot)+{1\over2\tau}\widetilde Y,qquad
\widetilde Y(\bar\tau)=Y(\bar\tau).
\end{equation}
Then $|\widetilde Y(\tau)|^2=\tau/\bar\tau$. The Hessian estimate is
